name: Omakeylog
author: cesarfilho
description: Measures how often you press each key, key-pair and short sequence to help you design a better QMK keymap: home-row placement, thumb and layer keys, less finger travel, home-row-mod timing. It keeps aggregate counts only, never the text you type, and shows a keyboard heatmap, finger load, same-finger pairs, trigram patterns, shortcuts and a suggested TAPPING_TERM. It can use your Vial keymap for fingering.

barWidget.description: Key-frequency analyzer for QMK layout tuning: records per-key, pair and sequence counts (no text) and shows a heatmap, finger load, same-finger pairs, typing timing and layout suggestions.
